Question
========
What does the Laos case study show?

Answerlist
----------
* Growth reduced monetary poverty while non-income deprivation and disparities between groups persisted or grew
* Growth eliminated all forms of poverty
* Monetary and multidimensional poverty always identify the same people
* Inequality in Laos is much smaller than global inequality

Solution
========
Monetary poverty fell by about 40%, but malnutrition remained widespread and inequalities, especially between ethnic groups and regions, were as large as global ones.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
